# whet.extend

A sharped version of node.extend as port of jQuery.extend that **actually works** on node.js



## Description

Its drop-in replacement of [node.extend](https://example.invalid/dreamerslab/node.extend), re-factored and re-written with CoffeeScript

I just need some more CS practice AND its fun :)
